use-nerdfont-icons.description: Enable Nerd Font icons in the UI. Default: true.

image-diffs.description: Render inline image diffs (via the kitty graphics protocol) in the status diff panel on supported terminals. Default: true.

stage-diff-context-lines.description: Number of context lines shown around each diff hunk in the staging view. Clamped to 0–20. Default: 1.

input-modal-bottom.description: Vertical position of the text-input overlay. An integer means fixed lines from the bottom, a percentage string (e.g. "5%") means a fraction of screen height from the bottom, and "center" places it in the middle of the screen. Default: "5%".

oneOf.description: Fixed number of lines from the bottom of the screen.
Percentage of screen height from the bottom (e.g. "5%").
Center the overlay vertically on the screen.

name-aliases.description: Exact full-name aliases used for kitty session names.

max-agents-per-epic.description: Maximum agents that may run concurrently within one epic. Default: 2.

max-agents.description: Maximum live agents across every project (the server's slot cap). Default: 4.

max-one-off-agents.description: Maximum agents that may run concurrently across one project's one-off tickets. Default: 3.

retry-storm-launches.description: Consecutive failed launches of one ticket before it is paused as retry-exhausted. Default: 3.

spin-cycles.description: Pause/re-claim cycles of one ticket within spin-window before it is quarantined as spinning. Default: 3.

spin-window.description: Go duration string (e.g. "5m") bounding the spin-cycles count. Unparsable or non-positive values keep the default. Default: "5m".

waiting-slot-grace.description: Go duration string (e.g. "10m"). A waiting agent counts toward the slot caps this long, then releases its slot and stays alive. Unparsable or non-positive values keep the default. Default: "10m".

max-released-agents.description: Maximum waiting agents that may hold a released slot at once, across every project. The next waiting agent keeps its slot. 0 disables release. Default: 5.

stalled-nudge-delay.description: Go duration string (e.g. "2m"). An idle agent with no open question and no finished report gets one nudge after this long, telling it to run `gx tickets ask` if it waits for a person. Unparsable or non-positive values keep the default. Default: "2m".

budget.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost soft/hard limits and notification thresholds, in dollars.

soft-limit.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost soft limit in dollars. 0 disables it. Default: 300.

hard-limit.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost hard limit in dollars. 0 disables it. Bumped up to soft-limit if set at or below a nonzero soft-limit. Default: 350.

notification-thresholds.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost thresholds in dollars at which a notification fires. Sorted and deduped. Default: [50, 100, 150, 200, 250].

important-refs.description: Rules for highlighting important refs in the log view. Refs matching a rule get a bright colored badge; all others get a dim surface badge. Rules are evaluated in order — the first match wins. The order also controls sort priority: refs matching earlier rules appear first.

patterns.description: Regular expressions matched against the full ref name (e.g. "^main$", "^origin/main$", "^v\\d").

color.description: Badge color. Named Catppuccin colors: blue, green, yellow, orange, mauve, teal, red, surface. Or a hex value: #rrggbb or #rgb.

hide-refs.description: Regular expressions matched against the full ref name. Matching refs are hidden from the log view entirely. Takes priority over important-refs. Default: empty (nothing hidden).

telegram.description: Telegram bot credentials for sending notifications. An empty bot-token disables Telegram notifications.

chat-id.description: Telegram chat id to send notifications to. Default: empty.

slack.description: Slack workflow webhook for sending notifications. An empty webhook-url disables Slack notifications.

webhook-url.description: Slack workflow webhook URL (accepts a single {"text": "..."} body). Default: empty (disabled).

tcp-listen.description: Also listen on loopback TCP (127.0.0.1:7421), serving the same routes as the socket. No auth.

allowed-hosts.description: Host names the web listener accepts in the Host header, besides IP literals and localhost (e.g. a MagicDNS name). Matched without the port, case-insensitively. Any other Host gets a 403. Reloads without a restart.

totp.description: Whether web login asks for a TOTP code besides the password. Reloads without a restart; signed-in web logins stay signed in.

dev-frontend.description: Dev only: serve the web UI from the Vite dev server at dev-url instead of the embedded build. /v1 stays on gx. Startup-only.

dev-url.description: Loopback http URL of the Vite dev server used when dev-frontend is true.

tab-env.description: KEY=VALUE entries set on every iteration tab's shell, to override what the shell rc would decide (e.g. PATH). Default: empty.

watch-config.description: Reload this config file automatically when it is saved. `gx server reload-config` works either way.

log-retention.description: Go duration string (e.g. "168h") for how long a headless agent's logs outlive its last activity. Unparsable or non-positive values keep the default. Default: "720h" (30 days).

agent-runner.description: How the server runs agents. auto uses herdr when it answers within 2s, else headless. herdr requires herdr to be up; headless requires claude on PATH. Checked when the server starts. Default: auto.

runner-wait.description: Go duration string (e.g. "10s") for N, the wait every agent runner bounds its guards by. Unparsable or non-positive values keep the default. Read when the server starts. Default: "5s".

evolve.description: What the retro hook does when an epic completes. A project opts out with evolve: false in its project file.

evolve.deep-read-cap.description: Maximum deep-read subagents in one gx-evolve run.

recovery.description: Recovery catalog: automatic investigation of paused tickets.

enabled.description: Global kill switch for the recovery catalog. Default: true.

disabled.description: Catalog entry IDs to switch off. Default: empty.

follow-ups.description: Epic (project:epic) that receives the draft research tickets an investigate ticket files. Default: gx:follow-ups.

notify-hold.description: Go duration string for how long a pause's chat message waits for recovery before it is sent anyway. Unparsable or non-positive values keep the default. Default: "10m".

cpu-watchdog.description: gx watches its own CPU use (the server and each TUI). A sustained spike captures a CPU profile and goroutine dump under the state dir's cpu-spikes/ and, in evolve maintainer mode, files a ticket in the gx project for an agent to find the cause.

enabled.description: Turns the watchdog on. Default: true.

threshold-percent.description: CPU use, in percent of one core and counting subprocesses, that counts as high. Non-positive values keep the default. Default: 15.

sustain.description: Go duration string for how long the use must stay high before a spike fires, and low before it can fire again. Default: "1m".

cooldown.description: Go duration string for the least time between two spikes: evidence captures per process, and filed tickets. Default: "6h".

disk-space.description: When gx warns about low free disk space, when it cleans, and the command it cleans with. Sizes are strings such as "20G", "500M" or "1500000000" (a bare unit letter is decimal: G is 10^9 bytes; "GiB" is 2^30). A config reload applies them with no restart.

warn-below.description: Free space below which gx warns. "0" turns the warning off. Raised to clean-below when it is non-zero and lower. Default: "20G".

clean-below.description: Free space below which gx runs cleanup-command. "0" turns cleaning off. Default: "10G".

cleanup-command.description: The cleanup command as an argv list, not a shell string. An empty list turns cleanup off. A project's project.json can replace it. Default: ["go", "clean", "-cache"].

suppress-extra-usage-warning.description: Permanently silence the extra-usage-enabled warning once you have acknowledged it. Default: false.

ticket-store.description: Where the global ticket store lives.

path.description: Absolute path of the ticket store. Default: <data dir>/tickets (~/.local/share/gx/tickets, honoring XDG_DATA_HOME).

commit-debounce.description: Seconds of quiet after a ticket-store change before the store commit loop commits it.

push-remote.description: Git remote of the store to push to after each commit, best effort. Empty means no push.

skills.description: Which skill(s) gx-implement-equivalent work and code review run under.

implement.description: Skill invoked for ticket-implementation work. Default: gx-implement.

code-review.description: Skill(s) invoked for code review. Default: [gx-thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review].

agents.description: Coding agent settings: the model and effort level each agent runs under, and the interactive (Agents tab) session keys. For model/effort: an absent key uses gx's built-in default; an explicit empty string ("") means "inherit" — gx passes no flag for that knob, leaving the agent CLI's own configuration in charge. Values are passed through as-is (trimmed of surrounding whitespace) and are never validated against a model/effort allowlist.

claude.description: Model/effort for the claude agent. Default: model=sonnet, effort=medium.

model.description: Model passed to the claude CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: sonnet.

effort.description: Effort level passed to the claude CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: medium.

codex.description: Model/effort for the codex agent. Default: model=gpt-5.6-sol, effort=medium.

model.description: Model passed to the codex CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: gpt-5.6-sol.

effort.description: Effort level passed to the codex CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: medium.

default-harness.description: The harness new sessions use. The server will not start when its program is not on PATH (under agent-runner auto or pty). A project's project.json can override it. Default: claude.

leader-key.description: Key (or list of keys) that starts a leader sequence in the Agents tab. A malformed or blank value falls back to the default. Default: ctrl+a.

focus-sidebar-key.description: Key (or list of keys) that moves focus from the Agents terminal to the sidebar, showing the sidebar if hidden. The leader then this key sends it to the session. A malformed or blank value falls back to the default. Default: ctrl+q.

restore-sessions-on-start.description: Restore the interactive sessions that were running when the server last stopped. Default: true.

enabled.description: Show a banner when an interactive session finishes or needs attention. Default: true.
Play a sound when an interactive session finishes or needs attention. Default: true.

done.description: Sound file played when a session finishes, relative to the config dir. Empty means the built-in sound.

attention.description: Sound file played when a session needs attention, relative to the config dir. Empty means the built-in sound.

claude-args.description: Extra arguments passed to claude in interactive sessions. Default: none.

fix-agent-remote-control.description: Start Claude fix-agent sessions with --remote-control <ticket address>, so they can be driven from the Claude app. Other harnesses and session kinds ignore it. Default: false.
